name: GlitchPad
description: Glitch²-style XY pad for NTS-3. Keeps a tempo-synced AUDIO IN buffer (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and plays Illformed-style scenes from the pad. Untouched = bypass. Hold to glitch. X = scene (RTRG, REV, SHUF, TAPE, STRCH, GATE, CRUSH, DLY), Y = slice / rate (1/2 to 1/64), Depth = wet. DECAY fades repeats / tape / delay feedback. CRUSH stacks lo-fi. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MODE
params.detail: Scene: RTRG retrigger, REV reverse, SHUF shuffle, TAPE tape stop, STRCH granular stretch, GATE trance gate, CRUSH bitcrush, DLY tempo delay

params.name: TIME
params.detail: Slice length / rate. Bottom = long (1/2), top = short (1/64), tempo-synced

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: Retrigger fade, tape-stop length, gate smoothing, delay feedback

params.name: CRUSH
params.detail: Extra bitcrush / sample-rate reduction stacked on the wet path

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to glitch. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
